flows.description: Anonymous visitor requests portfolio pages and submits contact inquiries via web browser
Administrator accesses CMS content management dashboard and editing interfaces
Administrator authenticates with Firebase Authentication to obtain Firebase ID JWT token
Next.js Server Components and route handlers fetch public content and forward contact submissions
Admin studio sends REST requests with Firebase ID Bearer token in Authorization header
Server verifies Firebase ID tokens and checks revocation status via Firebase Admin SDK
NestJS services execute parameterized queries and transactions through Prisma 7 adapter
Server queries session blocklist, caches API responses, and manages rate-limiting counters
Server issues presigned S3 upload/read URLs and manages object deletions via AWS S3 SDK
NestJS Sentry SDK transmits unhandled exceptions and performance breadcrumbs
Next.js client-side Sentry SDK captures browser rendering errors and uncaught exceptions
CMS studio client-side Sentry SDK captures administrative interface exceptions

threats.title: Automated scraping bots flooding contact form
threats.description: Automated scraping bots flooding contact form endpoint with commercial spam inquiries
threats.mitigation: Honeypot field and backend CAPTCHA/bot verification

threats.title: Volumetric HTTP flooding against Next.js dynamic
threats.description: Volumetric HTTP flooding against Next.js dynamic App Router routes causing compute starvation
threats.mitigation: Rate limit at edge/reverse proxy and configure endpoint throttling

threats.title: Privilege escalation through vulnerable npm dependency
threats.description: Privilege escalation through vulnerable npm dependency within Next.js runtime container
threats.mitigation: Container runs as non-root user portfolio (UID 1001)

threats.title: Inadvertent leakage of backend environment variables
threats.description: Inadvertent leakage of backend environment variables into public client browser bundle
threats.mitigation: Next.js strictly isolates server-only variables without NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix

threats.title: Production secrets written into .env file
threats.description: Production secrets written into .env file during CI build baked into Docker container filesystem layers
threats.mitigation: Exclude .env in .dockerignore and inject secrets at container runtime

threats.title: Injection of malformed or XSS payloads
threats.description: Injection of malformed or XSS payloads through contact form input fields
threats.mitigation: Client-side Zod schema validation and string trimming

threats.title: Rapid mass-deletion or modification of CMS
threats.description: Rapid mass-deletion or modification of CMS content by rogue editor account
threats.mitigation: Implement distributed rate limits and granular administrative audit logging

threats.title: Memory exhaustion in client browser when
threats.description: Memory exhaustion in client browser when rendering massive unpaginated datasets
threats.mitigation: TanStack Table v8 server-side pagination with controlled limits

threats.title: Bypassing client-side route guards to render
threats.description: Bypassing client-side route guards to render unauthorized administrative screens
threats.mitigation: Backend API authoritatively enforces RBAC on all mutation endpoints

threats.title: Unauthorized read access to draft portfolio
threats.description: Unauthorized read access to draft portfolio projects and user messages
threats.mitigation: Backend RolesGuard restricts CMS data access to ADMIN and EDITOR roles

threats.title: Administrator denying content modifications or deletions
threats.description: Administrator denying content modifications or deletions performed in CMS
threats.mitigation: AuditLogService records actor ID, entity ID, and timestamp in PostgreSQL

threats.title: Replay of stolen Firebase ID token
threats.description: Replay of stolen Firebase ID token to access CMS management interface
threats.mitigation: Enforce short token TTLs and server-side session revocation checks

threats.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Markdown
threats.description: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Markdown CMS editors executed in editor browser
threats.mitigation: React auto-escaping, DOMPurify, and strict Biome linter sanitization

threats.title: High-frequency password guessing or brute-force attempts
threats.description: High-frequency password guessing or brute-force attempts bypassing in-memory throttler
threats.mitigation: Store throttler state in Redis with distributed persistent rate counters

threats.title: Automated HTTP request flood on public
threats.description: Automated HTTP request flood on public contact submission endpoint exhausting database resources
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict per-IP rate limiting and backend bot detection on contact routes

threats.title: Last administrator demoting own account to
threats.description: Last administrator demoting own account to standard user causing system lockout
threats.mitigation: Enforce self-demotion checks and ensure at least one active administrator remains

threats.title: Bypassing session revocation checks when token
threats.description: Bypassing session revocation checks when token is absent from Session database table
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict token existence check and maintain revocation list in Redis

threats.title: Leaking database errors, table schemas, or
threats.description: Leaking database errors, table schemas, or stack traces on unhandled exceptions
threats.mitigation: GlobalExceptionFilter intercepts exceptions and redacts 500 error traces

threats.title: Failure to record security events or
threats.description: Failure to record security events or user modifications during database service failure
threats.mitigation: Atomic database transactions wrap critical data updates with audit records

threats.title: Spoofing client IP address via X-Forwarded-For
threats.description: Spoofing client IP address via X-Forwarded-For header due to unconstrained trust proxy setting
threats.mitigation: Restrict trust proxy to trusted reverse proxy CIDR blocks

threats.title: Cross-origin framing or clickjacking due to
threats.description: Cross-origin framing or clickjacking due to disabled Content Security Policy in Helmet
threats.mitigation: Configure Content Security Policy header in Helmet middleware

threats.title: Registering arbitrary storage keys or unverified
threats.description: Registering arbitrary storage keys or unverified file metadata via media upload completion endpoint
threats.mitigation: Validate S3 object existence and size using S3 HeadObject before saving

threats.title: Accidental schema reset or destructive migration
threats.description: Accidental schema reset or destructive migration execution dropping production tables
threats.mitigation: Engineering policy and CI/CD enforce prisma migrate deploy; migrate reset prohibited

threats.title: Connection pool starvation due to synchronous
threats.description: Connection pool starvation due to synchronous session lookups on every API request
threats.mitigation: Cache active session validation state in Redis with sensible TTL

threats.title: Database superuser privilege abuse to read
threats.description: Database superuser privilege abuse to read local filesystem or execute OS commands
threats.mitigation: Run PostgreSQL service under dedicated unprivileged system account with least privilege

threats.title: Eavesdropping on unencrypted database network traffic
threats.description: Eavesdropping on unencrypted database network traffic across local network
threats.mitigation: Configure database connection with sslmode=require and enforce TLS encryption

threats.title: Unauthorized connection to PostgreSQL database port
threats.description: Unauthorized connection to PostgreSQL database port from compromised internal network node
threats.mitigation: Require strong database authentication password and isolate database subnet

threats.title: SQL Injection via raw SQL queries
threats.description: SQL Injection via raw SQL queries altering or deleting database records
threats.mitigation: Prisma 7 ORM uses parameterized queries exclusively; raw unescaped SQL forbidden

threats.title: Redis service downtime crashing backend API
threats.description: Redis service downtime crashing backend API requests
threats.mitigation: CacheService implements fallback error handling to directly query PostgreSQL

threats.title: Execution of dangerous Redis commands (CONFIG,
threats.description: Execution of dangerous Redis commands (CONFIG, FLUSHALL) compromising database host
threats.mitigation: Disable dangerous commands via rename-command in redis.conf

threats.title: Unencrypted Redis communications exposing session hashes
threats.description: Unencrypted Redis communications exposing session hashes and rate limit data on local network
threats.mitigation: Enable Redis TLS encryption for all client connections

threats.title: Unauthenticated command execution against Redis server
threats.description: Unauthenticated command execution against Redis server when REDIS_PASSWORD is not set
threats.mitigation: Enforce mandatory REDIS_PASSWORD and Redis ACL user authentication

threats.title: Cache poisoning modifying cached API responses
threats.description: Cache poisoning modifying cached API responses or clearing session revocation keys
threats.mitigation: Secure Redis access with authentication and validate cache data integrity

threats.title: Unauthorized users signing up via Firebase
threats.description: Unauthorized users signing up via Firebase client SDK to gain unauthorized system access
threats.mitigation: Newly created users receive USER role with zero CMS permissions by default

threats.title: Firebase API service outage or rate-limiting
threats.description: Firebase API service outage or rate-limiting blocking administrator sign-in
threats.mitigation: Google Cloud multi-region high availability and enterprise SLA

threats.title: Malicious user assigning self-proclaimed roles via
threats.description: Malicious user assigning self-proclaimed roles via Firebase custom user claims
threats.mitigation: RolesGuard authoritatively checks database roles in PostgreSQL; Firebase claims ignored

threats.title: Leaking Firebase service account private key
threats.description: Leaking Firebase service account private key allowing full project administrative takeover
threats.mitigation: FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY injected via secret environment variables and redacted from logs

threats.title: Credential stuffing or password brute-force against
threats.description: Credential stuffing or password brute-force against Firebase Authentication endpoint
threats.mitigation: Google Firebase Identity Platform enforces brute-force protection and account lockout

threats.title: Forging JWT claims or signatures to
threats.description: Forging JWT claims or signatures to impersonate administrators
threats.mitigation: FirebaseAuthGuard cryptographically verifies token signatures with Google public certs

threats.title: Replaying expired presigned upload URLs or
threats.description: Replaying expired presigned upload URLs or tampering with S3 upload signatures
threats.mitigation: AWS S3 cryptographically validates SigV4 signatures and rejects modified requests

threats.title: Uploading excessively large files via presigned
threats.description: Uploading excessively large files via presigned URL exhausting S3 storage quota
threats.mitigation: Enforce Content-Length-Range restrictions in presigned URL policy

threats.title: Uploading executable or malicious HTML/SVG files
threats.description: Uploading executable or malicious HTML/SVG files resulting in stored XSS via CDN
threats.mitigation: Validate MIME types and enforce Content-Disposition: attachment for non-image assets

threats.title: Public enumeration of S3 bucket objects
threats.description: Public enumeration of S3 bucket objects exposing unlinked administrative files
threats.mitigation: S3 Block Public Access enabled; files served through CloudFront CDN with strict origins

threats.title: Interception and unauthorized reuse of presigned
threats.description: Interception and unauthorized reuse of presigned PUT upload URL
threats.mitigation: Presigned URLs restricted to short 900-second TTL and specific randomized keys

threats.title: Overwriting legitimate media files by uploading
threats.description: Overwriting legitimate media files by uploading to existing storage keys
threats.mitigation: Keys generated using collision-resistant random UUIDv7 and timestamp prefixes

threats.title: Injecting misleading crash reports to obscure
threats.description: Injecting misleading crash reports to obscure active security attacks or generate alert fatigue
threats.mitigation: Sentry allowed domains restrictions and server-side issue fingerprinting

threats.title: Flooding public Sentry DSN endpoint with
threats.description: Flooding public Sentry DSN endpoint with synthetic events exhausting error quotas
threats.mitigation: Sentry edge rate limiting, event filtering, and client sampleRate limits

threats.title: Leaking Sentry auth tokens in CI/CD
threats.description: Leaking Sentry auth tokens in CI/CD pipeline allowing unauthorized access to project issues
threats.mitigation: Protect SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN in GitHub Actions Secrets and prevent layer leakage

threats.title: Sensitive user credentials, Bearer tokens, or
threats.description: Sensitive user credentials, Bearer tokens, or PII transmitted in Sentry breadcrumbs
threats.mitigation: Sentry beforeSend hook sanitizes headers, cookies, and removes sensitive payload data

threats.title: Spoofing Sentry ingestion server via DNS
threats.description: Spoofing Sentry ingestion server via DNS hijacking to capture application exceptions
threats.mitigation: Sentry SDK enforces TLS with strict certificate verification

threats.title: Modifying Sentry configuration variables in runtime
threats.description: Modifying Sentry configuration variables in runtime to suppress security alerting
threats.mitigation: Sentry configuration is set via immutable environment variables at deployment
